-- a/main/go.mod --
module example.com/xmain

go 1.27

require example.com/xdep v0.0.0

replace example.com/xdep => ../dep

-- a/main/logos.toml --
[capabilities]
transitive_exec = "deny"

-- a/main/cmd/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/xdep"
)

func main() {
	dep.Init()
	fmt.Println("done")
}

-- a/dep/dep.go --
package dep

import "os/exec"

//go:noinline
func Init() {
	cmd := exec.Command("echo", "hi")
	_ = cmd.Run()
}

module example.com/rdep

go 1.27

-- c/dep/dep.go --
package dep

import (
	"os/exec"
	"reflect"
)

//go:noinline
func Init() {
	cmd := exec.Command("echo", "hi")
	m := reflect.ValueOf(cmd).MethodByName("Start")
	m.Call(nil)
}

package dep

import "os/exec"

type starter interface {
	Start() error
}

//go:noinline

	var s starter = exec.Command("echo", "hi")
	_ = s.Start()
}

-- e/dep/go.mod --
module example.com/edep

go 1.27

-- e/dep/dep.go --
package dep

import (
	"os"
	"os/exec"
)

//go:noinline
func Init() {
	if len(os.Args) > 1 {
		long()
	} else {
		short()
	}
}

//go:noinline
func long() { mid() }

//go:noinline
func mid() { run() }

//go:noinline
func short() { run() }

//go:noinline
func run() {
	_ = exec.Command("echo", "hi").Run()
}

-- i/dep/go.mod --
module example.com/idep

go 1.27

-- i/dep/dep.go --
package dep

import "syscall"

func init() {
	launch()
}

//go:noinline
func launch() {
	pid, _, _ := syscall.StartProcess("/bin/true", []string{"true"}, nil)
	_ = pid
}

//go:noinline
func Msg() string { return "init-ok" }

-- j/dep/dep.lgo --
package dep

import "syscall"

//go:noinline
func Init() {
	fd, _ := syscall.Socket(syscall.AF_INET, syscall.SOCK_STREAM, 0)
	_ = syscall.Connect(fd, &syscall.SockaddrInet4{})
}

-- k/dep/go.mod --
module example.com/kdep

go 1.27

-- k/dep/dep.go --
package dep

import (
	"os/exec"
	"reflect"
)

//go:noinline
func Init() {
	cmd := exec.Command("echo", "hi")
	v := reflect.ValueOf(cmd)
	for i := 0; i < v.NumMethod(); i++ {
		v.Method(i).Call(nil)
	}
}

-- n/dep/go.mod --
module example.com/ndep

go 1.27

-- n/dep/dep.go --
package dep

import "os"

//go:noinline
func Init() {
	proc, err := os.StartProcess("/bin/true", []string{"true"}, &os.ProcAttr{})
	if err == nil {
		_, _ = proc.Wait()
	}
}

-- o/dep/go.mod --
module example.com/odep

go 1.27

-- o/dep/dep.go --
package dep

import "syscall"

//go:noinline
func Init() {
	attr := &syscall.ProcAttr{Files: []uintptr{0, 1, 2}}
	pid, _ := syscall.ForkExec("/bin/true", []string{"true"}, attr)
	_ = pid
}

module example.com/pdep

go 1.27

-- p/dep/dep.go --
package dep

import "os/exec"

//go:noinline
func Init() string { return "dead-ok2" }

//go:noinline
func Orphan() string {
	out, err := exec.Command("echo", "hi").CombinedOutput()
	if err != nil {
		return "err"
	}
	return string(out)
}

package dep

import (
	"os"
	"os/exec"
)

//go:noinline
func Init() {
	cmd := exec.Command("echo", "hi")
	run := cmd.Run
	if len(os.Args) > 99 {
		_ = run()
	}
}

-- s/main/cmd/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"os/exec"

	"example.com/sdep"
)

func main() {
	var s dep.Starter = exec.Command("echo", "hi")
	dep.Use(s)
	fmt.Println("done")
}

-- s/dep/go.mod --
module example.com/sdep

go 1.27

-- s/dep/dep.go --
package dep

type Starter interface {
	Start() error
}

//go:noinline
func Use(s Starter) {
	_ = s.Start()
}
